title: Farm Equipment Mechanics and Service Technicians
description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul farm machinery and vehicles, such as tractors, harvesters, dairy equipment, and irrigation systems.

tasks.text: Reassemble machines and equipment following repair, testing operation and making adjustments, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Reassemble equipment after repair.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Maintain, repair, and overhaul farm machinery and vehicles, such as tractors, harvesters, and irrigation systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on engine teardown and repair

dwas.name: Repair defective engines or engine components.
Service vehicles to maintain functionality.

tasks.text: Examine and listen to equipment, read inspection reports, and confer with customers to locate and diagnose malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.
Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Record details of repairs made and parts used.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Dismantle defective machines for repair, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Repair or replace defective parts, using hand tools, milling and woodworking machines, lathes, welding equipment, grinders, or saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Test and replace electrical components and wiring, using test meters, soldering equipment, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.
Install machine or equipment replacement parts.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle component adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust vehicle components according to specifications.

tasks.text: Drive trucks to haul tools and equipment for on-site repair of large machinery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating heavy equipment by hand in field

dwas.name: Move large objects using heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Fabricate new metal parts, using drill presses, engine lathes, and other machine tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Repair bent or torn sheet metal.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Repair structural components.

tasks.text: Calculate bills according to record of repairs made, labor time, and parts used.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.

tasks.text: Install and repair agricultural irrigation, plumbing, and sprinkler systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pipe leak repair requires hands-on manipulation

dwas.name: Install piping for installation or maintenance activities.
Repair pipes to stop leaking.
